ownParaphrase: The method distinguishes a finite detection limit from absence: a non-detect concerns a sample result relative to an analytical limit. Matrix and sample preparation can change method performance.
inferenceForThesePixels: A qualitative copper assay remaining blue does not establish literal zero reducing sugar. This conclusion concerns the general non-detection versus absence distinction; no numerical Benedict/Fehling detection limit is imported from an environmental method.
